title: Policy Control, Approval and Traveller Care Modules by Programme Tier
content:
Five modules govern how a booking is controlled before it is released and how travellers are looked after once they are away: the travel policy engine, the levels of approval the workflow supports, the duty of care module, live traveller tracking and destination risk alerts. Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes carries its own combination of them.

The columns below carry the six tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes in rank order: the Business Starter Programme, the Business Team Programme, the Business Pro Programme, the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.

|  | Starter | Team | Pro | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Global |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Travel policy engine enforcing the company's rules at booking | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Levels of approval the workflow supports before a booking is released | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 |
| Duty of care module | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Live traveller tracking | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included |
| Destination risk alerts | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |

## Module notes

- **Travel policy engine.** Enforces the company's own booking rules at the point of booking. It is carried by the Business Team Programme and every tier above it; the Business Starter Programme does not carry it.
- **Approval workflow.** The number of approval levels a booking may pass before it is released runs 0 on the Business Starter Programme, then 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 across the tiers above it.
- **Duty of care.** Carried by the Business Pro Programme and above; not carried by the Business Starter Programme or the Business Team Programme.
- **Live traveller tracking.** Carried by the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme alone.
- **Destination risk alerts.** Carried by the Business Pro Programme and every tier above it.

## Points of judgement

**A company on the Business Pro Programme asks which of these five it holds.** That tier carries the travel policy engine, 2 levels of approval, the duty of care module and destination risk alerts; live traveller tracking is not carried at that tier.

**A company on the Business Enterprise Programme asks the same.** That tier carries all five, with 3 levels of approval.
